notes: Metadata-only build profile; the executable and decrypted payload are not stored in Git.
The executable_sha256 identifies the EBOOT.BIN SELF container used by the existing BCUS-98158 analysis.
The embedded ELF entry is an ELFv1 PPU function descriptor; code 0x00010230 is the executable entry routine.
The profile is US-specific and must not be merged with other GT5 Prologue regions or revisions without validation.
Provenance: normalized from the repository's existing BCUS-98158 executable analysis.
